Subject: CAIQ mapping + telemetry proof request

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for taking time with our security team yesterday. To keep our audit moving I wanted to confirm a couple of concrete asks that AuditPartner needs to close out the CAIQ review for our procurement committee: 

1) A claimant index: a single spreadsheet mapping CAIQ controls to Redwood assertions (yes/no/compensating) with direct links to evidence artifacts.
2) A short runtime telemetry sample (trust but verify): anonymized log sample that shows tokenization telemetry + node assignment for a 5-minute synthetic workload.
3) Proof of key rotation procedure and a sample KMS entry log for an example rotation event.

Can you confirm delivery dates? Ideally we get the index and a telemetry sample by Fri, Jul 23 so the auditor can start parsing it next week. If you prefer we can set up a 30-minute walkthrough with AuditPartner to walk the artifacts.

If there are controls out of scope for Velvettech (e.g., tenant-specific encryption patterns), call them out in the index as "out_of_scope" with a short reasoning note.

Appreciate it — Alex

--
